note: Per-million-token USD rates for Gemini API models used by ADK agents. Prices change without notice -- verify against each entry's source_url before relying on a number for a real budget decision. Standard tier only (no batch/flex/priority).

cache_multipliers._note: Gemini's default (automatic/implicit) context caching bills only a read-time discount at 0.1x the model's fresh input rate -- verified per-model against ai.google.dev's published cached-input rates (every model checked divides out to exactly 0.1x). There is no cache-write surcharge and no cache_creation token field in GenerateContentResponseUsageMetadata (confirmed by inspecting the actual Pydantic model), so write multipliers are 0 by design, not a placeholder.

gemini-2.5-pro.note: Standard tier, <=200k token context only. Gemini bills >200k-context calls at $2.50/$15.00 per Mtok; this table has no per-call tiered-pricing logic, so long-context Pro calls will be under-priced by this evaluator. See README.

gemini-2.0-flash.note: Deprecated by Google (shut down 2026-06-01). Kept for pricing historical eval sessions recorded before the shutdown; will not appear in new runs.
